title: VPS and proxy list prices by country, 2026-10 snapshot
description:
Public list prices of VPS/VDS hosting (603 offers, 25 providers, 32 countries) and paid proxies (458 rows, 31 brands), taken from providers' own pricing pages between 2026-08-30 and 2026-09-24. Two CSV files with a source URL and an observation date on every row. RUB and EUR are converted to USD at a fixed Bank of Russia snapshot dated 2026-09-24.

Curated list, mostly providers relevant to Russian-speaking buyers; not the whole market. List prices only. The always-current version is at https://researched.xyz/en/vps.
